settings.ekit_heading_title: Choose the Right Kind of Solar Help
settings.ekit_heading_extra_title: Whether your system needs repair, an independent inspection, battery planning, electrical capacity, or an EV charging circuit, the first step is the same: get a clear explanation before spending more money.

image.alt: Solar repair technician checking rooftop solar equipment for a Dallas-Fort Worth homeowner

settings.editor: If production dropped, alerts keep returning, or the original installer is gone, we help identify the likely fault and explain the next practical repair step.

image.alt: Solar technician reviewing system information for an inspection report

settings.editor: Independent solar system inspections help owners, buyers, sellers, and legal teams understand visible condition, system concerns, and sensible next steps.

image.alt: Solar battery and electrical equipment being reviewed for a Dallas-Fort Worth property

settings.editor: Battery planning starts with the system you already own, how much backup you expect, and whether the existing inverter and electrical setup can support the plan.

image.alt: Technician reviewing solar and electrical equipment for panel capacity planning

settings.editor: Panel upgrades are planned around real capacity needs, not assumptions. We help clarify whether solar, battery, or EV charging work needs electrical changes first.
Home EV charging should match the vehicle, parking location, daily mileage, and panel capacity so the installation is practical from day one.
